desc:
Water Physics is Roblox's most realistic ship building and sinking simulator! 🌊

Build ships, sink them and rescue NPCs!

You take full control of the sinking, and you can create holes in the hull, flood compartments, or even completely destroy the ship with rockets and torpedoes, and watch as each ship goes down with realistic physics and buoyancy. Each sinking is completely unique!

Our build system allows for the creation of customised ships to your taste, with custom hulls, hundreds of part templates and more!
 
Our advanced destruction system lets you completely tear ships apart, with absolutely no pre-scripted events! The ship can be decimated fully dynamically. 

Spawn NPCs and watch them scramble to the lifeboats before rescuing them!

Drive the ship around in an ocean that ocean can be completely customized with icebergs, sea mines, massive waves and even tsunamis!

You can play solo or multiplayer, either in a public lobby or a private game with friends.
